metaDeps.description:
Forward dependencies are Types or fields that this Type relies on for a portion of
its behavior. Any forward dependencies for this #typeMeta instance are stored here.

**NOTE**: For {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.TypeInfoBase}, these will only contain _new_
          dependencies introduced by the remix.

backwardMetaDeps.description:
Backward dependencies, as opposed to [regular ones](metaDeps), are Types or fields that
rely on this Type for a portion of their behavior. Any backward dependencies for this
#typeMeta instance are stored here.

resolvedInheritedFields.description:
For any fields that are declared as [inherited](InheritedValueType), the fully resolved
{@link DeclaredFieldType} is stored here. We can't overwrite the existing {@link DeclaredFieldType}s
because we need to know what information has been inherited and what has been explicitly
declared on a Type to figure out whether to report a change.

The key is the field name and the value is an array of resolved {@link DeclaredFieldType}s.
An array is used because a {@link Method} can have multiple [overloads](Method#overloads).
For most fields, this will only contain 1 element.

title:
Base wrapper Type for {@link TypeMeta} containing extra information not stored directly
on the {@link TypeMeta} instance such as backward dependencies and upstream/downstream
remix packages.

@see BaseCodeAnalyzer#collectAppInfo
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.TypeInfoBase
